description: Turn a script, brief, or idea into a finished 9:16 video for Reels and TikTok, following the skills in skills/ (start with skills/creative-video-production.md).

requirements.name: ffmpeg
requirements.purpose: Encoding, mixing and frame extraction (render, bgm-extend, add-ons)

requirements.name: playwright-core
requirements.purpose: Drives Chromium in tools/render/render.js (the render stage)

requirements.name: @spira-lab/cli
requirements.purpose: Every generated asset, uploads and the credit balance (skills/toolkit.md)

requirements.name: spira sign-in
requirements.purpose: The Spira CLI must be signed in as the operator to generate or upload anything

requirements.name: openai-whisper
requirements.purpose: Word timings for the voice-over (tools/make-timings.py, the timings stage)

requirements.name: yt-dlp
requirements.purpose: Downloading a reference video from a URL (add-ons.md reference add-on)

inputs.description: Reference video material, as given by the operator; the agent works out how to use it

stages.title: Read skills and preferences, start clock, preflight CLI
Choose video type, hook and style
Create editable, materials folder and metadata
Build word timings from the voice-over
Report credits, minutes and deletable sizes

outputs.description: Public URL of the published render, when it was uploaded
